capture_scope: The first selected real block has16 linked machine records. Both captures compare full opcodes/flags, header live sets, source markers, branch label identities and every active register/memory operand.

Before placement, ECX and EDX identify the exact load record at contextual index1. After placement the source marker precedes the load, its800000 placement bit is set, and the next register-width query receives4022 in ECX.
The parameter memory home matches symbol kind1/id9266/name_message with displacement0, EBP base5 and zero index; no raw heap addresses are used as identities.
The source work body has already changed from expressions to a machine block here. The debugger locates its exact owning WorkItem and does not reinterpret released expressions or allocation bitsets.

Only the first real scalar block has completed transfer placement; later blocks, stores and pinned call-boundary placement remain unvisited. find_transfer_call_boundary still traps.
